checks.exercise: Wide-stance kettlebell sumo squat with knees tracking outward and controlled descent.
checks.equipment: One kettlebell with horizontal two-handed handle; sphere hangs below the handle.
checks.setup: Front and side eight-frame sheets inspected; spine held with torso, feet apart.
checks.hands: Both curled hands retain the same handle sockets through the full cycle.
checks.feet: Both feet and toes stay planted without drift.
checks.movement: Knees and hips flex for squat; bell lowers between legs and stays below waist; torso remains mostly upright.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; kettlebell does not touch the floor.
Elbows retain approximately 20 degrees of flexion; no visible floor; sole clearance about 0.0325 model units.
Seventeen sampled vertex-to-bell checks do not certify full mesh collision, handle clearance or human biomechanics.
